sources.snippet: 1. General Information Inkling-Small is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text, image and audio inputs and generates text outputs. It is intended for use in English and other languages, and across multiple coding languages. sources.title: Introducing Inkling-Small - Thinking Machines Lab
sources.snippet: Today, we are releasing Inkling-Small, an efficient open-weights model that achieves comparable performance to Inkling at a quarter of its size. Inkling-Small is a Mixture-of-Experts transformer with 276B total parameters, 12B active, trained on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems. Like Inkling, it features native reasoning over audio and images, variable thinking effort, a context window of up to 1M ...
